integrity: The general proof uses only Aratake's published existential forcing clause and Theorem 3.14 plus elementary facts about the finite Boolean algebra of regular elements. The bundled computation checks finite examples but is not used to infer the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The Łoś conclusion retains Aratake's function-symbol Assumption.

The Boolean special case of automatic fullness is already implicit in Pierobon–Viale; novelty is claimed for the finite Heyting consequence, sharp regular-atom optimization, and complexity formulation.
The result is a short corollary/refinement of published machinery and may exist as unindexed folklore.
title: Finite Heyting truth values force Łoś, with Set-Cover witness complexity
